user.title: Set up SMHI Weather Context
user.description: Choose the Swedish location for which weather observations and historical context should be provided.

data_description.use_home: Use the latitude and longitude configured for this Home Assistant installation.
data_description.name: A name used for the location device and its entities.
data_description.latitude: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.
data_description.longitude: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

content.title: Choose weather context
content.description: Select the SMHI products to include. Temperature and wind use MetObs station data. Climate context uses PTHBV grid data.

data_description.enable_temperature: Add current and historical temperature entities.
data_description.enable_wind: Add current and historical wind entities.
data_description.enable_climate: Compare current station observations with PTHBV climate data.
data_description.enable_precipitation: Include precipitation from PTHBV. This is climate grid data, not a current station observation. Climate context must also be enabled.

comparisons.title: Choose historical comparisons
comparisons.description: Select the complete year offsets to compare with the current local hour and day.

data_description.comparison_years: Select one or more offsets from 1 to 30 years.

stations.title: Choose observation stations
stations.description: Choose compatible SMHI stations. Temperature and wind may use different stations. The integration never changes a station without your approval.

data_description.temperature_station: Station used for both current temperature and all temperature history comparisons.
data_description.wind_station: Station used for both current wind and all wind history comparisons.

confirm.title: Confirm setup
confirm.description: Confirm {location}. Temperature station: {temperature_station}. Wind station: {wind_station}. Historical data is downloaded after setup and can take time to become available.

confirm_climate_unavailable.title: Confirm setup — climate service unavailable
confirm_climate_unavailable.description: Confirm {location}. Temperature station: {temperature_station}. Wind station: {wind_station}. SMHI's climate service (PTHBV) could not be reached, so climate coverage could not be checked. You can finish setup now. Climate remains enabled and downloads are retried automatically, but climate sensors remain unavailable until data can be retrieved for this location. Historical observations are downloaded after setup.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SMHI Weather Context
reconfigure.description: Update the location. The following steps let you review data products, comparison years, and stations before saving.

data_description.use_home: Use the latitude and longitude configured for this Home Assistant installation.
data_description.name: The name shown for the location device.
data_description.latitude: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.
data_description.longitude: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to SMHI. Check the network connection and try again.
error.invalid_response: SMHI returned an unexpected response. Try again later.
error.outside_coverage: The location is outside the verified coverage of the selected SMHI product.
error.no_temperature_station: No compatible temperature station with sufficient historical coverage was found.
error.no_wind_station: No compatible wind station with sufficient historical coverage was found.
error.station_incompatible: The selected station does not provide both current observations and a corrected historical archive for every required parameter.
error.select_feature: Select at least one of temperature, wind, or climate context.
error.select_comparison: Select at least one historical comparison year.

init.title: SMHI Weather Context options
init.description: Choose enabled data products and historical comparison periods. Saving these options reloads the integration.

data_description.enable_temperature: Enable current and historical temperature entities.
data_description.enable_wind: Enable current and historical wind entities.
data_description.enable_precipitation: Include precipitation from PTHBV climate grid data.
data_description.comparison_years: Choose which previous years are exposed as comparison entities.

error.reconfigure_required: Reconfigure the integration to select a compatible station before enabling this data product.

wind_deviation_10_year.name: Deviation from ten-year mean wind speed

station_unavailable.title: Selected SMHI station is unavailable
station_unavailable.description: SMHI station {station_id} for data type {kind} is no longer compatible. Open the integration's configuration and select another compatible station. The integration will not change stations automatically.
